population: The canonical records the Perpres partition leaves RESIDUAL — bucket `residual-besar-observed` of scripts/kbli_filiera/perpres_body_default_relation.py, i.e. on no Lampiran I/II/III row over the BPS 2020->2025 crosswalk, named by no body article, reached by no Pasal 11(2) sector-law carve-out, and carrying an observed Usaha Besar row in the PP 28/2025 licensing annex — that are published TERBUKA/100 under `declared_gap`. Lot 1 narrows that to the records that change ONE client-facing thing: Bali overlay OK_or_HIGHER_RISK and not blocked, so no provincial claim is unveiled; no legacy PMA prose (`pma_kondisi`, `pma_nota`, `pma_prioritas`, `pma_cap_note` all empty), so nothing generator-era is published under the basis line; no ADJUDICATED 4-digit sibling and no hand-excluded body-stated category, so the lot never publishes openness-by-absence where an instrument is demonstrably in the neighbourhood. Arithmetic: bucket 879 = 874 published TERBUKA/100/declared_gap + 5 already adjudicated (4 TERTUTUP/0/located, 1 TERBUKA/100/located); 874 = 543 Bali-OK + 331 deferred on the Bali axis; 543 = 507 rule-reached + 36 deferred on legacy prose; 507 = 329 shipped here + 178 withheld, and the 178 are 67 on an unswept sector statute + 61 on the Pasal 11(2) instrument referral + 29 on an adjudicated 4-digit sibling + 19 on a body-stated category + 2 on an annex title collision. Every one of those figures is re-derived on each run and refused on any drift; none is a stored count.
adjudicated: 2026-09-18 — dossier research/kbli/2026-09-18-kbli-codes-closed-to-pma-tier1-tier2-dossier.md SS2.2 (the four-way partition, read verbatim) and SS8.5 (whole-catalogue residual-open relabel, owner decision); Zero's go the same day, in lots with a gate.
decisive_test: Absence, re-derived from the instrument on every run by perpres_body_default_relation.report() and refused on any set difference in EITHER direction. Pasal 3(1)(d) is residual to 3(1)(a)-(c), so membership is exactly 'no annex row, no body article, no sector-law carve-out'; Pasal 3(2) supplies the verdict ('dapat diusahakan oleh semua Penanam Modal') and the canonical already publishes it (TERBUKA/100) -- this spec relabels the VERIFICATION state, it never flips a verdict or a cap.
what_this_rests_on_and_does_not_prove: It rests on the three annex parsers and the BPS 2020->2025 crosswalk being complete: a code wrongly missing from a Lampiran II/III row would be relabelled open here. The crosswalk gap is the dossier's own declared gap (SS7), and it is not hypothetical -- `annex_title_collision_probe` is the measured half of it, covering the one shape we can test without re-reading the annexes by hand (a NUMBER re-scoped between vintages while the annex names the ACTIVITY). It covers that shape only: a code missing from an annex for any other reason still passes. It does NOT prove the absence of a SECTOR statute outside the Perpres -- the sectoral sweep covered the carve-out list and the dossier's named classes, not all 1,559 codes -- and the basis string says so. It says nothing about OSS licensing (risk tier, scale, zoning) nor about the Pasal 7(1) >Rp10bn Usaha Besar test a particular PMA must meet. The Pasal 2(2) category legs rest on a COARSE, fail-closed substring probe over the whole record (`category_closure_probe`), pinned to the four codes it marks today: it withholds on a match and refuses the whole run if that census moves, but a category closure is about the ACTIVITY, and no probe over a code record can clear an activity carried on under an open code.

sector_referral.why: «Perizinan berusaha dan pelaksanaan kegiatan dalam rangka Penanaman Modal untuk Bidang Usaha keuangan dan Bidang Usaha perbankan dilaksanakan sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan di bidangnya masing-masing» — the Perpres hands the whole finance/banking sector to its own legislation, so absence from its annexes is evidence that the instrument never reached the code, NOT that the code is open. data/kbli-filiera/sector-law-carveout.json carries this text verbatim yet enumerates only six insurance codes (65111 65112 65121 65122 65201 65202): that is the same UNDER-match one level up (superscar #3), because the referral's unit is the sector the article names, not the six codes somebody listed under it. Without this leg the lot shipped 64121 — conventional commercial banking — as residual-open with a verified 100% cap, under a basis string that asserts «no Pasal 11(2) sector-law carve-out reaches it».

sector_referral.instrument: UU 22/2001 Migas · UU 30/2009 Ketenagalistrikan · UU 17/2008 Pelayaran · UU 1/2009 Penerbangan · UU 38/2009 Pos · UU 36/1999 Telekomunikasi
sector_referral.why: Energy, transport, logistics and telecommunications carry foreign-ownership provisions in statutes OUTSIDE the Perpres, and this lane swept the Perpres annexes only. The basis string already declares that gap — but declaring a gap is not a licence to publish a VERIFIED 100% cap over it, and `pma_cap_verified` is exactly what a client reads as the percentage. This is OUR caution, not the instrument's: nothing here asserts these codes are closed, they stay `declared_gap` until a lane actually reads the statute. MEASURED, not assumed: the canonical already carries 23 located TERBATAS/49% caps in these divisions (50111-50135, 50211-50223, 51101 51102, 53200, Perpres 10/2021 and 49/2021 Lampiran III), so the residual codes here sit beside an adjudicated cap — and the 4-digit sibling leg cannot see it, because 5011/5012/5013 are capped while 5014 is not: sea transport was withheld at 50127/50139 and would have shipped at 50143 50144 50145 50149. The unit is therefore the DIVISION. Divisions 09 35 49 52 61 carry no adjudicated cap in the canonical today; they are withheld under the same principle rather than on their own evidence, because the sweep that would tell them apart is exactly the one this lane did not run.

category_closure_probe.finding: Measured on the canonical 2026-09-18: the state marks this category per code in its OWN licensing rows — the persyaratan «Melampirkan Surat Pernyataan tidak memproduksi senjata kimia dan industri yang menghasilkan Bahan Perusak Ozon/BPO» / «Menjamin kegiatan usaha tidak menghasilkan produk … senjata kimia dan/atau bahan perusak ozon» — and it lands on exactly four codes, all in division 20: 20115 (Kimia Dasar Organik dari SDA Hayati), 20116 (Kimia Dasar dari Minyak Bumi, Gas Alam dan Batu Bara), 20119 (Kimia Dasar Anorganik Lainnya) and 20121 (Senyawa Nitrogen; Pupuk). The residual rule cannot reach any of them, and not because this spec excluded them: the Perpres partition already owns all four — 20115 is `named-in-annex`, 20116/20119/20121 are `priority-lampiran-i`. Of the 37 KBLI-2025 codes in division 20 this lot ships 13 (20112 20125 20132 20211 20212 20221 20222 20223 20291 20293 20295 20296 20299) and NOT ONE carries the marker. What this does NOT prove: the marker is a PP 28/2025 licensing condition, not a statutory enumeration, so a code without it could still HOST the closed activity — which is what «closed by activity» means. The verdict this lot writes is provenance only: all 13 were already TERBUKA/100 in the canonical before it and are TERBUKA/100 after it. Raised by kimi-code/k3 HIGH (3), council round 1; folded as an enforced probe rather than a hand exclusion because a hand exclusion would have been a claim about codes the rule never reaches.

The third, 30303 «Industri Wahana Antariksa», DOES descend from the capped 30300 — and `perpres_slice_disclosure_relation.ADJACENT_NOT_CONTAINED` already adjudicates it by hand, with its reason in the tree: «spacecraft; the annex restricts military aircraft». annex_title_collision_probe.annex: Perpres 10/2021 Lampiran III — persyaratan tertentu, the foreign-ownership caps
annex_title_collision_probe.why: Absence from Lampiran III is matched by CODE, through the BPS 2020->2025 crosswalk. BPS also RE-SCOPES numbers between vintages, and where it does, the two matchings disagree: the cap follows the activity the annex names, the crosswalk follows the number. 2020-58120 was «Penerbitan Direktori dan Mailing List» and 2020-58130 was the press row; in 2025 the two swapped and 58120 IS «Penerbitan Surat Kabar». The code therefore passed an absence test it should have failed, and lot 1 shipped it TERBUKA with a VERIFIED 100% cap over Lampiran III entry #33, which reads 0% at establishment (49% via the capital market for expansion only). Found by the on-disk gate on the first candidate (PR #6783, REWORK-BUILD) — the class was invisible to every leg the compiler had, because each of them reasons about the code NUMBER.
annex_title_collision_probe.scope: Lampiran III only. It is the one annex carrying a `foreign_cap_pct`, so a hit is a cap this lane would be contradicting rather than a partnership condition. Lampiran I's artifact (perpres-priority-codes.json) holds codes and no titles, so the test cannot run there at all; Lampiran II (perpres-umkm-reservation.json) carries an OCR-uncorroborated row whose entire text is «Industri» (10721, title_corroborated false), which matches every industrial title in the catalogue and produced 82% of the raw hits when the probe was measured across all three annexes.
annex_title_collision_probe.finding: Measured on the canonical 2026-09-19: normalised containment in either direction between a code's 2025 `judul` and the `bidang_usaha` of a Lampiran III row filed under a DIFFERENT code fires on 9 of 1,559. Eight are the sea-transport renumbering inside divisions 50 and 53 (entries #11 #13 #14 #15 #17 #22 #32, all 49%), which the `unswept_sector_statute` referral already withholds by division — an independent corroboration that the probe finds the class it is aimed at rather than noise. The ninth is 58120 -> entry #33, and it is the only one this lot had shipped. Cost of the leg to lot 1: one member, 330 -> 329.

sector_law_closures.instrument: UU 40/1999 Pers · UU 32/2002 Penyiaran · UU 30/2004 Jabatan Notaris
sector_law_closures.why: Four codes whose own sector statute closes or hard-caps foreign ownership, none of which any Perpres leg can see: 58120 «Penerbitan Surat Kabar» (press, UU 40/1999 — and Lampiran III #33 prices the same activity at 0% at establishment); 60101 «Aktivitas Penyiaran Radio Analog» and 60201 the television twin (UU 32/2002 Penyiaran, whose foreign-capital regime is its own); 69104 Notaris/PPAT, an entity-form closure rather than a cap at all — a notaris is a *pejabat umum* appointed by the state, a role no PT PMA can hold. THIS BLOCK IS NOT A SUBTRACTION. The codes are out of the lot today for reasons unrelated to any of that — 58120 by the title-collision probe, the other three by the Bali overlay and eligibility filters — i.e. BY ACCIDENT, and an accident stops being protection the moment a later lot lifts the filter (lot 2 carries the ATTENZIONE_FASCIA_BALI class, lot 3 the BLOCCATO_DIPENDE_SCOPE one). So the compiler REFUSES the whole run if any of these is ever listed, or is ever reached with no leg holding it. A statute closure is an adjudication a human owes; it is deliberately not something this compiler may absorb silently. Raised by the on-disk gate on PR #6783 as the standing half of its BLOCK: «when the Bali cut is lifted the same rule reaches 69104 with nothing to stop it».
